rungs.note: 4 researchers, beats: gov/edu + primary-source award mining, energy/grid/data-centers/defense, fisheries/wildlife/Native/rural, outlet index wildcard. Search budget respected: round one capped at 4 researchers with an explicit 20-WebSearch cap each. The fisheries researcher self-reported ~30 calls, over its cap, and that is recorded here rather than hidden.
rungs.result: thin on three of four beats; most live territory sat on the 30-day exclusion list
produced the locked story (ADN 2026-08-02) plus the NTSB Bering Air and Girdwood raven candidates
surfaced the NSF GAIA/EarthScope cluster (2532369, $4.99M, 2026-07-16) but its Alaska arm is award 2608510, already covered on 2026-07-25; correctly not resurfaced under a new framing

candidates_evaluated.headline: One curator, 400,000 records, and the classifier that has been ready since 2008
candidates_evaluated.why: in-window, fact-checked hard including the 2008 Systematic Biology paper by DOI, fresh subject with no 30-day neighbour, and an AI angle that is honest in the direction this channel does best: it says precisely where the technology does and does not bind

candidates_evaluated.headline: Vision-guided ike jime robot arrives in Cook Inlet's sockeye fleet
candidates_evaluated.why_not: genuinely strong and in-window, but it would be the THIRD computer-vision-and-salmon Dispatch in 30 days after Wood River sockeye counting (07-10) and NOAA AFSC bycatch YOLOv11 (07-21). dedupe.py flagged the overlap on computer/fish/sockeye/vision. The viewer test decided it, not the token count: a third fish-vision film inside a month reads as monotone. Held as a strong lead for a later run, by which point the Alaska-outlet coverage gap may also have closed.

candidates_evaluated.headline: NTSB final report on Bering Air Flight 445
candidates_evaluated.why_not: no AI angle at all (a conventional autopilot is not machine learning), and a 10-fatality crash is the wrong subject for this format's characterized-object register

candidates_evaluated.headline: A raven blacked out Girdwood
candidates_evaluated.why_not: charming and in-window but the AI content is nil; it is a tonal counterweight, not a story about AI

candidates_evaluated.headline: Aleut Corporation subsidiary launches AI-focused 8(a) joint venture
candidates_evaluated.why_not: announced 2026-06-04, outside even the 30-day lookback, and the AI content is reseller/integrator rather than Alaska-built

candidates_evaluated.headline: UAA rural AI mini-grants hit first report deadline
candidates_evaluated.why_not: primary-source program pages only, no outcomes published; a credible pipeline story rather than a result. Worth a follow-up once the cohort's final reports surface.

candidates_evaluated.headline: Space Force awards Rocket Lab $266M for Kodiak hypersonic tests
candidates_evaluated.why_not: in-window and well sourced, but the researcher checked explicitly and found no AI/ML/autonomy angle in any primary source

locked_story.title: The Net Comes First
locked_story.hook: Anchorage Daily News profile of Derek Sikes, 2026-08-02, three days before this run
entities: university of alaska museum of the north
locked_story.dedupe: dedupe.py check returned DUP only on the generic tokens 'alaska' and 'north', both of which come from the institution's own name. Re-tested and treated as spurious per the routine's generic-token clause. No subject neighbour exists in the 30-day window.
locked_story.headline: The classifier has been ready since 2008. Alaska's insect count still moves about a thousand species a decade, because the step that is starved is the one before the model.
